quick_english: That, sevenfold, six-and-half-fold scripture, is taught by the Supreme Lord alone.
There: Śivas, mantra-great-Lords, mantra-Lords, mantras, knowledge-portions, dissolution-portions, complete — seven power-bearing.
Of these seven powers, by their difference up to the earth-and-rest principal tattva: each its own form by fourteen differences — fifteenfold.

There: own form fit-for-knowability, self-established, by grace of Aparābhaṭṭārikā — in power-raised knower-objects the rest-receptacle: that is the śākta form by grace of Śrīmatparāparā; that too sevenfold, from the powers being so many.
In power-bearing-form-principal, in the knower-class, what rests: that power-bearing Siva-form by grace of Śrīmatparābhaṭṭārikā — sevenfold too.
From Śiva to the complete-limit — from those many being said.

There: difference of knower-objects from power-difference alone; for clarification it is said by order of complete-and-rest: in complete, knowledge-portion's power, from being its specific form (mind-action-instrument-powers); dissolution-portion's, those same from objectlessness, in indistinct.
Knowledge-portion's: those same in dissolving-portion, helper of its impression, awakening — pure-knowledge of mantra.
Devoid of that impression: she alone awakened, of mantra-Lord.
She alone, desiring to seize will-power-form, autonomy-natured, of mantra-great-Lord.
Will-natured, distinct-autonomy-natured, of Śiva — thus the power-differences: seven primary.

And difference in power-bearing knower-objects made by its tainting: from instrument-difference ending in agent-difference; from power alone — non-separate — being able to act; not other's, from fallacy of infinite regress and rest.

In reality one alone — consciousness-autonomy-bliss-resting knower; there earth, own-nature-merely-resting, when known, its own nature alone shines: seen-by-mind's-eye, known-by-mind, I-know — there made-by-complete-power, made-by-power-bearing-form, other-own-nature shines too; thus up-to-Siva also to-be-said: Siva-power-established, Siva-nature-resting world I-know — from conviction being different.

But if state's knowability is own body, then knowability-toward-all, knowability-of-knowable too: infinite-regress; by that, world-blindness well-luminous; by that, union-with-opposite-qualities in knowable-unknowable: fault — so said here.

Not that own body: from own-nature being separately said; but what: in knower-power and knower the rest-receptacle, the form — that self-luminous itself shines toward nothing: thus omniscience, infinite-regress-opposite-quality-union — far-removed.

Known-by-infinite-knower-objects too: one alone, its form in those — from one-shining-form-nature: no obstruction by other-knower's-knowing-inference; that its form real, from doing work-for-meaning; likewise seeing beloved seen-by-other becomes-jealous: Siva-nature, seeing rest-pot, enters-completely; seeing reality resting-of-all-infinite-knower-objects becomes-full, like-watching-a-dancer; her blue's form in knower as rest — from self-luminous contemplation's arising: thus fifteenfold-nature of earth up-to-principal-tattva.
In that-much raised-passion-and-rest-curtain's complete's knower-nature: thus fifteenfoldness of complete too, from its that-much knowability.
Spread, this is settled in the Tantrāloka.
From male up to segment-tattva: thirteenfold.

Complete's there, by union-with-knower-nature, from suppression of its two differences power/power-bearing-self: thus complete's own-nature merely; dissolution-portion's in-own-nature, five's in-knower-nature: eleven differences.
Knowledge-portion's in-own-nature, four's in-knower-nature: nine differences.
Mantra's in-own-nature, three's in-knower-nature: seven.
Mantra-Lord's in-own-nature, two's in-knower-nature: five.
Mantra-great-Lord's in-own-nature, the Lord's one-alone in-knower-nature, from power-power-bearing-difference: three.
Śiva's too — dependent-on-light-one-consciousness-autonomy: no difference at all, from fullness.

Thus tattva-difference itself established in Supreme-Lord-unsurpassable-policy-one-name makes world-difference-variegation: of hell-heaven-rudra-worlds, earthness being equal too, from farther nature-difference being said.
And here, each-other by construction-of-difference, curious-for-inner-difference-knowledge: let him determine Tantrāloka alone.
Thus by following each pot-and-rest too, earth-and-rest tattvas' difference is established.
Now the whole earth-tattva, knower-known-form targeted, is established: what by earth-tattva-non-difference is light — that Śiva.
As the Vedic text: in earth this very brahman.

It impels giving-earth-tattva-attainment: earth-mantra-great-Lord; impelled earth-mantra-Lord; his made-of-imagined-image-nature expressive mantra, by order of Sāṃkhya-and-rest-bonded-knowledge-crossed-Siva-knowledge, practiced-earth-yoga, not-reached-stable-stage: earth-knowledge-portion.
By bonded-knowledge-order practiced-earth-yoga: at cosmic-end or in death, earth-dissolution-alone.
In deep-sleep from subjection-to-tattva-immersion alone varied dream's arising would be; earth-identity-grasped: earth-complete.
Even here by power-raising-absence-nature: fourteen-foldness — thus earth-tattva's differences of attaining-knower-nature; own-nature pure knowable — thus elsewhere-herein-even.

Now in one knower, by being-established-in-breath, difference-determination here: blue-grasping one, breath sixteen-segment-self up-to-knowable-immersion rises. There first segment indivisible-one-form; second knower-exultation-form; last knowable-identical pervaded; penultimate manifested-knower-form; in middle, the twelve-segment — from among them first six-group non-conceptual-natured, covering-concept sixness by own-nature: one segment; in covering-concept five-form-nature, dawning-willingness, already-dawned — she two-segment-bodied from pulsation's absence-of-one-instant-form, own-work-agent-nature — thus from fivefoldness-of-covering-concept and own-nature six instants non-conceptual; then from non-conceptual's dissolution-likeness: dissolution of concept, dawning-willingness, two-segment-bodied already-dawned: six segments.
Own-work-agent-nature is knower-form-nature — said; she not counted further — thus wise-wealthed practising-teacher's-instruction distinguish fifteenfoldness everywhere by division.
In concept-lack: segment-lack, in bliss-and-rest-knowing like — as far as non-conceptualness-alone.

Worlds too by concept-rest: that ego-made, spread-of-this-being-concept-covered-by-ego, non-conceptual contemplation-abode unlit — consider; suffering-state bliss-resting — like; by concept-decrease she shines indeed — thus this attentiveness in relation of knowable-knower: Abhinavagupta-teachers.

Thus in fifteenfold standing, as far as distinct this-ness-self's difference's lack, so much pair pair diminishes; as far as two-segment Śiva-immersion: there first segment everywhere complete; second pervaded-by-all-knowledge-instruments being-practised, fit for-omniscience-omnipotence — not first.
As Śrīkallaṭa says: segment-fall — here the fall-word: she alone the Goddess Śrīmatkālī, mother-being-nature, Bhairava, intuition — enough, by-secret-and-unsecret.
Thus from mantra-great-Lord-segment onward, from practice of that-and-that, attainment of that-and-that.

Now here the waking-and-rest states are established: the variegation of knowable and its object and consciousness — mutually-relative being — that state: not of knowable-merely, nor of consciousness-merely, nor two separate.
There when by object-rulership, by external-form-nature, shining: waking-state, in-knowable, in-mother, in-measure.
When too right-therein by substratum-form-nature shining — will: dream-state.
When too right-therein by ruler-form-nature shining, by seed-self-nature: deep-sleep-state.
These three known-instrument-knower-states, each by waking-and-rest-difference: fourfold said.

When too in knower-rest-gone, from knower's fullness-turning, by its door fullness-turning shining: fourth-state; she form I-see — of-this-kind triad-of-portions having-crossed I-see-thus: unmediated knower-nature, autonomy-essence, not by sameness-middleness-farness — gives anointing-of-knower-instrument-known-ness, from serving-three-states: threefold.
This four-state-set yogins employ by words piṇḍa-stha-padastha-rūpastha-rūpa-atīta; wealthy-in-contemplation: all-auspicious, pervasion, great-pervasion, accumulation — by words.
Corresponding-sense too here shown in Tantrāloka, in verse-marginalia.
What contained-in-all complete-form — that beyond-fourth, beyond-all, great-accumulation: they establish.

Moreover whose what when form distinct stable continuous — that waking; its opposite dream; which dissolution-portion's enjoyment: all-knowing deep-sleep; which knowledge-portion's enjoyment: identifying-with-enjoyable fourth; mantra-and-rest's: that enjoyment of states Siva-non-difference; beyond-fourth, beyond-all.
There self-nature-complete-pair: 1 dissolution-portion, 2 knowledge-portion, 3 mantra-those-Lords-great-Lords-class, 4 Śiva, 5 — thus in fifteenfold five states.

Self-nature dissolution-portion and-rest-by-order in thirteenfold self-nature knowledge-portion-power; knowledge-portion in-elevenfold self-nature mantras those-Lords great-Lords Śiva — in-ninefold self-nature mantra-Lords great-Lord power Śiva — in-sevenfold self-nature great-Lord-power great-Lord power Śiva — in-fivefold self-nature action-power knowledge-power will-power Śiva — in-threefold, in-non-different too, in Siva-tattva by-structuring-as-action-knowledge-will-bliss-consciousness-form, wealthy-in-contemplation-yoga: five-stage-nature they-say.
